name: Economy & Production Systems
summary: Overall good alignment between design and implementation. The core production formulas, population growth mechanics, and slider mathematics are implemented correctly. Found 3 high-severity issues: (1) racialProductionModifier not applied to factory output per design spec, (2) growth.ts file missing entirely, (3) potential double-counting of difficulty modifiers on factory output. Several medium-severity gaps relate to missing ship maintenance system implementation and incomplete food/starvation integration in the turn loop. Constants file is comprehensive and matches design documents well.

mismatches.actual_impl: Factory output only uses factoryEfficiencyMultiplier (for Mice), NOT racialProductionModifier. Code comment says 'racialProductionModifier applies ONLY to population labor, not factory output, to avoid double-counting'
mismatches.recommendation: The design doc explicitly shows racialProductionModifier applied to factory output. Either update the code to match design, OR update the design doc to clarify that racial production modifier only applies to population labor (and document how Mice's three stacking bonuses work). The current implementation may be intentional to avoid double-counting for Mice, but it contradicts the design formula.

mismatches.design_spec: Population growth system with logistic model, fractional tracking, cloning bonuses
mismatches.actual_impl: File does not exist - ENOENT error when attempting to read
mismatches.recommendation: Either create growth.ts or confirm population growth is handled entirely in population.ts (which does appear to have the implementation). If growth.ts is expected by other modules, create it as re-exports from population.ts.

mismatches.design_spec: Difficulty Modifiers: These modifiers apply to the final net production after cleanup costs.
mismatches.actual_impl: Difficulty modifier is applied separately to both factory production (line 173) AND population production (line 178), rather than once to final net production. This could result in double-application in some code paths.
mismatches.recommendation: Apply difficulty modifier once to the final netProduction value, not to factoryBC and popBC separately. Current approach achieves same mathematical result for gross production but the comment says 'after cleanup costs' suggesting it should be applied even later.

mismatches.design_spec: Ship_Maintenance = Ship_Cost × 0.02 (2% per turn), with racial modifiers, tech modifiers (Fleet Logistics), and minimum 1 BC
mismatches.actual_impl: No ship maintenance calculation system found in production.ts or any scanned economy files
mismatches.recommendation: Implement calculateFleetMaintenance() function per ship-costs.md, including racial modifiers (Ants 0.75, Mice 0.80, etc.), Fleet Logistics tech modifiers (multiplicative stacking), and minimum 1 BC per ship.

mismatches.design_spec: Handle bankruptcy: scuttle ships randomly at 10% emergency scrap rate until treasury positive
mismatches.actual_impl: No bankruptcy handling or emergency ship scrapping found in production.ts
mismatches.recommendation: Implement handle_bankruptcy() function that scuttles ships at 10% emergency scrap rate when empire treasury goes negative, with morale and diplomatic reputation penalties.

mismatches.actual_impl: No conquest population reduction logic found in population.ts
mismatches.recommendation: Implement conquest population reduction in the invasion/conquest system. CONQUEST_POPULATION_REDUCTION and FERRET_CONQUEST_REDUCTION constants exist in constants.ts but are not used.

mismatches.design_spec: DEF slider builds missile bases at base cost 100 BC (reduced by Construction tech) and planetary shields
mismatches.actual_impl: Buildings system uses building data from JSON file but doesn't apply Construction tech reduction to missile base cost
mismatches.recommendation: The missile base cost reduction by Construction tech (mentioned in factory-formulas.md: same tech tree reduces factory cost) should be applied to missile base construction, similar to factory cost reduction.

mismatches.design_spec: Overcrowding: When current_population > max_population, growth halts and starvation reduces pop over time
mismatches.actual_impl: calculatePopulationGrowth() returns 0 growth when pop >= maxPop, but there's no explicit handling for the case where maxPop is REDUCED below current pop (e.g., bio weapon). The starvation system would need food shortfall to trigger.
mismatches.recommendation: Add explicit overcrowding check that triggers when maxPop is reduced below current pop, ensuring starvation mechanism activates even if food production is adequate.

mismatches.design_spec: Mice (Meklars) Special Ability: Mice receive +2 to their effective Robotic Controls level
mismatches.actual_impl: RACIAL_RC_BONUS is defined in constants.ts but there's no code in production.ts that applies this +2 RC bonus for mice when calculating operatingFactories
mismatches.recommendation: In operatingFactories() or when building ProductionContext, add logic to apply RACIAL_RC_BONUS[raceId] to roboticControlsLevel for Mice.

mismatches.design_spec: Bombed Factories: Factories_Destroyed = Bomb_Damage × Factory_Vulnerability; Factory_Vulnerability = 0.1 (10%)
mismatches.actual_impl: No FACTORY_VULNERABILITY constant or bomb damage factory destruction formula found
mismatches.recommendation: Add FACTORY_VULNERABILITY = 0.1 to constants.ts and implement factory destruction during bombardment.

mismatches.design_spec: At least one slider must remain unlocked (otherwise re-balancing is impossible)
mismatches.actual_impl: rebalanceSliders() returns error 'NO_UNLOCKED_SLIDERS' if all adjustable sliders are locked, but the check only looks at sliders OTHER than the changed one - doesn't prevent locking all 5 sliders
mismatches.recommendation: Add a check that prevents the user from locking all 5 sliders. The current check works for rebalancing, but UI should also prevent the lock action itself when it would leave 0 unlocked.

mismatches.design_spec: Rabbits Special: Can redirect overflow population to transports automatically
mismatches.actual_impl: RACIAL_SPECIAL_RULES.rabbits.auto_transport_overflow mentioned in design but not implemented
mismatches.recommendation: Implement auto-transport queuing for Rabbits when population reaches max capacity.

Defensive installation maintenance: missile_base=2 BC/turn, starbase=5 BC/turn, etc.
Troop transports: Light (50 BC, 5 troops), Heavy (100 BC, 10 troops), Assault (200 BC, 20 troops)
Population transport system: Colony Transport 50 BC, 1 BC/turn maintenance, 1 million pop capacity
Bio weapon max population reduction: Death Spores -10%, Doom Virus -25%, Bio Terminator -50%
Mice +50% factory efficiency from Automated Production ability (factoryEfficiencyMultiplier exists but needs to be set to 1.5 for Mice)
Bombed factory destruction: Factory_Vulnerability = 0.1 (10% of bomb damage)

researchMultiplier on Planet (Orion=4.0, Artifacts=2.0) - applied to TECH RP but not documented in slider-mathematics.md or factory-formulas.md
Stellar Converter building that converts gas giants to terran worlds over 50 turns - not mentioned in economy design docs (may be in technology/buildings docs)
NEBULA_CAPACITY_BONUS = 15 - bonus population capacity for planets in nebula systems, not mentioned in population-growth.md
PLANET_SIZE constant with TINY=20, SMALL=40, etc. - design docs explicitly say NOT to use hardcoded per-size constants, use generated base_population instead
Extensive combat constants (hit chance, range classes, damage sequence, etc.) - these belong in combat design area, not economy
